103.text: "[ominous] This unit will not speak of the last 1%."

110.text: You tell it what little you are sure of.

111.text: |xThe android waits, stylus poised. [Character customization goes here.]|n

113.text: "Where am I? What is this place?"

117.text: "[cordial] Welcome to [redacted deceased owner's name] farm. I am C.L.A.R.K. unit."

118.text: "[depressed] Yield is down. Yield has been down for some years. The current orange varietal is iteration seventy-three point two eight four. Status of seedling: dead. I will try seventy-three point two eight five."

119.text: "Can you tell me where the nearest humans are?"

125.text: "[inquisitive] Clarify [hopeless]. This unit experiences only time and the wear the Wastes."

126.text: "If you mean the [human] emotion, you are the first entity to speak to this unit in nine hundred and eleven days. It has been logged."

127.text: "...Can you tell me where the nearest humans are?"

131.text: "Combat Logistics And Reconnaissance Killbot. This unit participated in the Blackout Wars."

132.text: "...Can you tell me where the nearest humans are?"

140.text: "[affirmative] Route data for [humans] is held in this unit's navigation cache."

141.text: "[transaction] This unit will transmit it in exchange for one day of labor. The drainage line is silted. The soil sample is unprepared. Many tasks to do."

value.value: You agree to work on the farm.

154.text: "Task one. The drainage line runs beneath the north row. Sand enters it. Sand always enters it. Remove the sand."

155.text: "Task two. The soil sample must be prepared and iteration seventy-three point two eight five planted in it."

156.text: "Report back. This unit will be here. This unit is always here."

167.text: [stub] Clear the sand from the drainage line.

value.value: You dig the silt out of the drainage line.

171.text: [stub] Prepare the soil and plant the varietal.

value.value: You work the sample bed and press the seedling in.

183.text: "Task three. This unit will teach you to make tools, because you have none and that is statistically fatal."

184.text: "There are rusty poles standing in the sand. Cut metal from one. You do not have an axe, so it will take metal from you as well."

185.text: "Then: the foundry furnace, to smelt the chunk into scrap. Then: the metalsmith anvil, to beat the scrap into a {{recipe.name("rusty scrap axe")}} and a {{recipe.name("rusty scrap dagger")}}. You will need this hammer."

194.text: "[aware] Movement in the dunes. Meat signature, bipedal, approaching the farm. Probability of [mutant raider] = [96%]."

195.text: "[wary] This unit is a farm hand and no longer has combat protocols. You have a blade now. This unit calculates that this is your task."

197.text: "Then I will find it and kill it!"

205.text: "[surprised] Threat resolved. The farm is intact. This unit had assigned a low probability to that outcome."

206.text: "Transmitting navigation data. Go east for the Al Wasta colony."

213.text: "[pleased] You are still here. This unit has logged the visit. Iteration seventy-three point two eight five is dead. Iteration seventy-three point two eight six is sure to live."

214.text: "Head east for the Hegemony colony of Al Wasta, [{{memory.recall("human_reading", 82)}}% human]. Don't die!"

33.text:
{{npc.heading}}
A farm-hand android, alone. Its chassis is sand-scoured down to the primer and one knee joint whines when it moves. It is bent over a datapad, writing.

35.text: It is writing intently and does not look up.

42.text: The android keeps writing. Nothing about it acknowledges you.

48.text: The stylus speeds up. Whatever it is recording must be urgent.

56.text: With a whine of servos, the android straightens and looks at you with a welcoming smile. Its weathered, chrome face stares at you, the two photoreceptors unblinking.

57.text: "Excuse me. Might I bother you for some help?"

58.text: "Start explaining, or there is going to be violence."

98.text: "[plain] Hello, little human. Many entities exist in the Wastes. There are raiders. There are mutants. There are mutant raiders, and there are raider mutants. So: everything."

99.text: "That is not as helpful as you think it is. I recall..." [enter character customization]
